features: Automatically fetch updated model rates and price pending records. Offline, Tokenory uses the last fetched rates.
自动获取最新模型费率，补齐待计价记录。离线时使用上次获取的费率。
Keep today’s tokens or estimated cost in view with a floating mechanical counter. Choose from six positions. The counter follows your pointer’s display.
Enable optional rolling sounds and adjust their volume.
See confirmed Codex usage update live, with daily totals resetting at local midnight.
Estimate GPT‑6.2 Astra and Sol costs for long context, Fast, and Ultrafast.
Keep fewer automatic backups and previews to save disk space.
fixes: Fixed a crash when the counter readout became blank or shorter.
Switched to public release downloads to avoid GitHub API rate limits.

features: 用悬浮机械计数器查看今日 Tokens 或估算费用。支持六个位置，并跟随鼠标所在屏幕。
可开启滚轮音效并调节音量。
实时刷新 Codex 已确认用量，每日累计按本地时间归零。
支持 GPT‑6.2 Astra 和 Sol 的长上下文、Fast 和 Ultrafast 费用估算。
减少自动备份和预览文件的留存，节省磁盘空间。
fixes: 修复计数器读数变空或位数减少时的崩溃。
改用 GitHub 公开发布下载地址，避免 API 限流。

features: Compare completed turns by throughput, time to first token, and reasoning tokens. Throughput includes tool wait time.
See today’s throughput in the menu bar.
View speed data from supported log formats for 12 clients, including Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode.
查看已完成回合的吞吐量、首 Token 等待时间和推理 Tokens。吞吐量包含工具等待时间。
在菜单栏查看今日回合吞吐量。
支持 12 个客户端的部分日志格式，包括 Codex、Claude Code 和 OpenCode。
Hover over the activity calendar for a daily summary, or click to open that day.
Explore model trends, 30-day averages, and activity by weekday and hour.
Open Overview on the last seven days. Records and Sources remember where you left off.
Search the updated offline rate catalog and collapse providers.
Back up the ledger before rate updates and fill in pending estimates. Existing estimates keep their prior amounts.
悬停活动日历查看每日摘要，点击打开当天统计。
查看模型用量趋势、30 天均值，以及按星期和时段统计的活动分布。
总览默认显示最近七天。明细和来源页面会保留浏览状态。
搜索更新后的离线费率目录，按供应商折叠列表。
更新费率前自动备份账本，补齐待计价记录，并保留已有金额。

fixes: Fixed intermittent 504 errors when checking for updates. If your installed version still fails to update, replace the app once with the ZIP from GitHub.
修复检查更新时偶发的 504 错误。旧版若仍无法更新，可从 GitHub 下载 ZIP 手动替换一次。

features: Download and install updates inside Tokenory. You confirm installation and restart.
Check for updates daily by default. Change the frequency or turn automatic checks off in Settings.
paragraphs: If you’re upgrading from v0.1.2 or earlier, replace the app once using the ZIP. Your usage data and settings carry over.

features: 在 Tokenory 内下载并安装更新，安装和重启由你确认。
默认每天检查更新。可在设置中更改频率或关闭自动检查。
paragraphs: 从 v0.1.2 或更早版本升级时，请先下载 ZIP 手动替换应用。用量数据和设置会保留。

features: Check for updates from the Tokenory menu or Settings → General. Download and install the ZIP from GitHub.
Use the new counter design for the app and menu bar icons.
从 Tokenory 菜单或「设置 → 通用」检查更新，再从 GitHub 下载并手动安装。
应用和菜单栏图标换成机械计数器。
Estimate costs for Codex Auto Review. Use Recalculate Existing Estimates to update historical records.
See how many tokens are pending pricing in Overview and chart tooltips.
fixes: Centered time labels under the matching usage bars and cost points.

features: 支持 Codex Auto Review 费用估算。历史记录可通过「重新计算已有估算」更新。
总览和图表提示显示待计价 Tokens 数量。
fixes: 将时间标签与对应的用量柱和费用点居中对齐。

features: See today’s AI usage in the menu bar and break it down by date, tool, provider, or model.
Collect local usage across 42 client entries and import history from CC Switch and tokens.ci.
Keep source-reported costs, API rate estimates, and unpriced usage distinct.
Back up or restore your local ledger. The app supports English and Simplified Chinese.
在菜单栏查看今日 AI 用量，按日期、工具、供应商或模型查看明细。
采集 42 个客户端入口的本机用量，支持导入 CC Switch 和 tokens.ci 历史记录。
分开显示来源报告的费用、API 费率估算和待计价用量。
支持备份和恢复本地账本，界面提供英文和简体中文。
